answer_1.quote: We present a novel neural truth-conditional model for time series captioning

answer_2.quote: Automated metrics measure overlap between model generated caption and the reference ground truth captions. We report Perplexity (PPL), BLEU-3/4 (2002), METEOR, ROUGE-L (Rouge), and BertScore-Precision (BERT).

answer_4.quote: We recruit human annotators who are requested to provide a binary label on factual correctness (COR) of the captions for the test split. Each caption is annotated by three annotators, and the majority label is used.
